opportunities.name: GitHub user lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com summarising followers, top repo and latest post.
steps: Click GitHub search and type the username, press Enter
Click the Users results tab
Open the matching user profile
Note followers count and open top repo to read stars and language
Open mail compose, enter recipient hiring@example.com
Set subject 'Lead for <role>: <username>'
Type body summary with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post

instances.values: karpathy, ML Research Engineer, nanoGPT 63.8k stars
gaearon (typo gaeron corrected), Staff Frontend Engineer, react/react 251k stars

opportunities.name: Wikipedia lookup and save note
opportunities.description: Search a topic on Wikipedia, read the summary and save a short note with key facts in the notes app.
steps: Click Wikipedia search box
Type the topic and press Enter
Read the lead paragraph for key facts
Open notes app, click New note
Type the summary note and press Enter

instances.values: Midtown Manhattan, note combined with library result
Satya Nadella, note with microsoft.com 2014 snapshot

opportunities.description: Search a nearby place or compute walking directions from an address to a destination on OpenStreetMap.
steps: Click the Search box, select all, type query
Press Enter
Open the result or Directions
Select Foot mode, fill From and To
Press Enter and read distance and time
